changelog:
Initial release of Dashform skill – create and manage AI-powered forms, surveys, and quizzes via the Dashform MCP server.

- Supports structured and dynamic (AI-powered) forms, including surveys, quizzes, and feedback forms.
- Requires local Dashform MCP server and user authentication with session token.
- Provides step-by-step workflow: checks credentials, handles authentication, prompts for form details, references documentation/examples, and creates production-ready forms.
- Integrates with MCP tools: create_form (new forms) and create_reply (form responses).
- Ensures generated forms include welcome/end screens, questions, and theme.
- Instructions for saving configs and managing form/create scripts included.
